title: What is role prompting?

body.text: Role prompting means telling ChatGPT to
"play the part" of an expert in some field
. Starting with "Act as..." or "You are..." makes the answer more specialized and better targeted.

example: "You are a professional nutritionist. Suggest high-protein breakfast options for someone who works out."

title: Examples of role prompting

body.text: teacher, marketer, programmer, writer, or business consultant
. Naming a role helps ChatGPT adjust its tone, level of expertise, and perspective to fit the task.

example: "Act as a senior marketing consultant. Analyze the strengths and weaknesses of a newly opened local coffee brand."

options.text: It switches the model to a different type
It tells ChatGPT to take on the role of an expert in some field
It makes ChatGPT search the web

question: Which prompt is a correct example of role prompting?

options.text: "You are a lawyer specializing in labor law. Explain an employee's sick-leave rights."

question: What's the main benefit of role prompting?

options.text: It makes answers more expert and better targeted
It makes ChatGPT use the latest data from the internet

question: You want beginner-friendly advice on starting to save money. Which role fits best?

options.text: "You are a personal finance advisor. Explain it simply for a beginner."
